description:
Intetics Inc., a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data & BI Specialist to join our dynamic team.

Our client is an international organization supporting global environmental and sustainability initiatives. The project focuses on providing technical expertise to support the organization’s IT systems and technology operations, working closely with internal teams to address the needs of its international programs.

Responsibilities

  • Work with business stakeholders to define reporting requirements, agree on KPI definitions, and translate them into Power BI reports and dashboards.
  • Combine data from multiple sources using SQL and Power Query, and validate the results against source records.
  • Build and maintain Power BI semantic models, including table relationships and reusable DAX measures, so teams can report consistently on the same metrics.
  • Monitor data refreshes, investigate discrepancies, and improve the performance of SQL queries and Power BI reports.
  • Document data sources, transformation logic, and metric definitions to support ongoing maintenance and help users interpret reports.
  • 5+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or data engineering within the Microsoft data ecosystem.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Power BI and 3+ years of hands-on experience with SQL.
  • Experience building Power BI semantic models and interactive reports, including defining relationships and writing DAX measures.
  • Experience writing SQL queries and integrating data from multiple sources into reporting datasets.
  • Ability to clarify business requirements and explain reporting logic to non-technical stakeholders.
  • A relevant Microsoft certification, such as Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) or Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600).
